constraints.field: NLP and graph theory (graph neural networks for text classification)

method: Each criterion is scored 0-5 with evidence. score_percent is the weighted share earned on scored criteria only; score_range shows the total if unscored criteria were 0 or 5. Any blocker removes a candidate from the ranking no matter how high its other scores are. Novelty is capped at 2 unless the closest prior work was read in full, and at 1 when that work already ran the experiment.

criteria.meaning_of_5: Answers a question the field demonstrably cares about.
evidence: Two surveys published in 2024 and 2025 show the area is active [@wang2024; @rizvi2025]

criteria.meaning_of_5: Public, licensed, downloadable data of manageable size.

criteria.meaning_of_5: Fits the stated hardware with margin.

criteria.meaning_of_5: Few ways for the project to end without a reportable result.
evidence: Either outcome (MLP still competitive, or not) is reportable
